test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A man has invested ₹50,500 at a rate of 6% per annum simple interest for 2 years. Find the amount (in ₹) that he will receive after 2 years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Simple Interest** for 2 years = 6% × 2 = 12%

Total **Amount** percentage = 100% (Principal) + 12% (Interest) = 112%

Amount = 112% of ₹50,500 = 1.12 × 50,500

Amount = ₹56,560

**∴ The correct answer is ₹56,560.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹50,500

**Rate (R)** = 6% per annum

**Time (T)** = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = Principal (P) + Simple Interest (SI)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1a98f8f8fe8b522497bd9187be75ebb634c772a438238a952f51e64b72c6ed2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (50500 × 6 × 2) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 505 × 12

⇒ SI = ₹6,060

⇒ Amount = Principal + SI

⇒ Amount = 50500 + 6060

⇒ Amount = ₹56,560

**∴ The correct answer is ₹56,560.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI) Properties

Simple interest is calculated only on the **Principal** amount, meaning the interest earned remains the same every year if the rate and principal are constant.

Amount in SI

The total **Amount (A)** can also be calculated using the direct formula A = P × (1 + RT/100).

SI vs Compound Interest (CI)

For the **first year**, SI and CI are always equal if the interest is compounded annually. From the second year onwards, CI becomes higher than SI due to interest on interest.
